run_lammps_with_fairchem: run a LAMMPS simulation using a FairChem MLIP predictor with a given input script path
lookup_atomic_number_by_mass: lookup atomic numbers from atomic mass values with a 0.1 tolerance check
atomic_data_from_lammps_data: create an AtomicData object from LAMMPS position, atomic number, cell, and periodicity data
check_input_script: check a LAMMPS input script for force field commands that conflict with MLIP forces
FixExternalCallback: create a FixExternalCallback callable that computes MLIP forces and energy for LAMMPS timesteps
